column3: (they) call the toy of the Lord
(they) call the moving and unmoving world the toy of the Lord
playing for the sake of water
the playing ones, having approached them
of him who assumed a body in sport
of the body of a man in sport
the two roamed the forest with sports
his tuft of hair shaken in the absorption of play
for sport, having taken a human body now
named Akrura's praise? (praise of the cruel)
giving up anger, greed and so on
of those whose nature is anger, greed, untruth
from the arising of this fruit of anger
with wet clothes, bared thighs and breast regions
we are suffering, very wretched, for you
of the two distressed by the wicked
by afflictions, actions, ripening, and flow of qualities
the Lord, unimpeded in experience, non-dual, by afflictions, actions, ripening, flow of qualities
giver of affliction to those far from...
sometimes the abode of all faults
sometimes cold, wind and other divine (afflictions)
sometimes by royal rakshasas disturbed by time
sometimes once having known the falsity of sense objects
sometimes by the Self with ignorance
sometimes of the beloved of forest folk
sometimes with hair standing on end, remains silent
sometimes swallowed by a python serpent
sometimes turns back from evil, sometimes moves
sometimes with the motions of deer and birds
in the rasa assembly with sounding anklets
in the rasa assembly with sounding anklets, whose charming tale is praised by us
sounding, whose fame is sung by followers
hearts robbed by the sound of the sounding flute

of anger swollen at the smell of blood

you deserve to forgive the offence

one whose great burden is destroyed
in the form of begging forgiveness
flowing from nine doors, this house
salt, liquor, ghee, honey, curds, milk, nectar and water (oceans)

may he destroy, remover of the humble's distress
to test the valour of kings
the earth with one wheel, one umbrella, by Ajita
harming the earth rakshasas up to the end of the kalpa, worthy of the sun
in earth, water and so on
by earth and the like this
of the earth and other objects here
for the pleasure of lifting the earth
flung touchstone, shining on the chest
though thrown, with longing for the unreal objects
one whose wealth is lost, fallen
in the ocean of milk, the immortals' and demons' leaders
in the ocean of milk, the leaders of immortals and demons, churning, to obtain nectar
being bathed by the ocean of milk
hunger, thirst and the three humours
oppressed by hunger, thirst and fatigue
they afflicted by hunger and thirst
by hunger, thirst, disease and the like, O king
with agitated whale-swallowers (huge fish) and waves

from the division of the knower of the field
as owner of field and wealth
holy places resorted to by the worthy
in the field and so on
indifferent to the field, destroyer of enemies
welfare, their blessings destroyed by the Lord
with the brave, heroes and gods boasting without battle
this earth, of herbs and creepers
increaser of the earth, gods, brahmanas, animals, ocean
earth, water, fire, air, sky, mind, senses, objects
by earth, water, fire, wind, sky, mind, senses, objects, and elements
by jests, glances and smiles of the beauties of Vraja
by jests, glances and smiles of Vraja beauties, exciting
in a servant-split? (cutting at the servant)
of broken minds, even the wind
among the wicked, with self broken
like a glow-worm's light by day
in the cry of the child, sprinkling and cleaning
the sky, the Self, the desired Lord
sky and so on, mahat, the Unborn and so on, mind
in a harsh wind-wheel of dust rain
by donkeys, camels, cows, buffaloes, men
with date palms, mango, hog plum and others
following the wishes of the wicked
they are the wombs of the wicked
indeed the one of excellent fame
by a boon of the ditch filled
in the sky and the like
is distressed in the distress of ignorance
of the wearied by hard efforts, the arms squeezed
the Self like an unfinished remainder
as if the Self were a remainder, determined
appeared in the sky of those watching
may he protect from the sky
situated in the sky, the Lord's departure
